summary: Catalog of services and treatments with price and duration.
purpose: They're chosen when booking, quoting and invoicing. The duration sets the appointment length; services with a workflow have steps (sessions).
tips: Check 'Bookable online' so the patient can book it from the portal.
To use it on the aesthetic record: choose the unit of measure, check "Aesthetic service", save and complete the Aesthetics tab.

sales.services.field.category_id.description: Category to group them in lists and reports.

sales.services.field.bookable_online.description: The patient can book it from the portal.

sales.services.field.service_type.description: Service with a workflow: a treatment in several steps/sessions.

sales.services.field.indications.label: Instructions
sales.services.field.indications.description: What the patient is told before the appointment.

sales.services.field.unit_id.label: Unit of measure
sales.services.field.unit_id.description: What the applied or sold amount is measured in (U, ml, mg…). Required for an aesthetic service.

sales.services.field.is_aesthetic.label: Aesthetic service
sales.services.field.is_aesthetic.description: Adds it to the aesthetic record and enables the Aesthetics tab.

sales.services.tab.aesthetic.label: Aesthetics
sales.services.tab.aesthetic.description: How it is marked on the aesthetic record and its consent.

sales.services.section.aesthetic-config.label: Aesthetic record
sales.services.section.aesthetic-config.description: Tool, dose, limits, next appointment and aftercare. Saved separately from the service.

sales.services.field.aesthetic-follow-up.label: Suggested next appointment
sales.services.field.aesthetic-follow-up.description: Days until the follow-up offered when closing.

sales.services.field.aesthetic-aftercare.label: Aftercare
sales.services.field.aesthetic-aftercare.description: Sent by WhatsApp when closing the session.

sales.services.section.consent-template.label: Consent
sales.services.section.consent-template.description: The service's own text. Without one the generic text is used; changing it only affects new signatures.

sales.services.section.consent-variables.label: Variables
sales.services.section.consent-variables.description: Patient, doctor, service, product and date.

sales.services.field.is_lab.label: Lab work
sales.services.field.is_lab.description: When checked, the service can be picked in lab orders.

sales.services.field.lab_category_id.label: Laboratory category
sales.services.field.lab_category_id.description: Optional, lab work only. Orders with this service filter the labs by that category.
